question.text: Sodium stearate <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>16</mn></msub><msup><mi>COO</mi><mo>-</mo></msup><msup><mi>Na</mi><mo>+</mo></msup></math> is an anionic surfactant which forms micelles in oil. Choose the correct statement for it from the following :

options.text: It forms spherical micelles with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>16</mn></msub><mo>-</mo></math> group pointing towards the centre of sphere.
It forms non-spherical micelles with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><msup><mi>COO</mi><mo>-</mo></msup></math> group pointing outwards on the surface.

It forms spherical micelles with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>16</mn></msub><mo>-</mo></math> group pointing outwards on the surface of sphere

It forms non-spherical micelles with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>16</mn></msub></math> -group pointing towards the centre.

solution.text: Forms spherical micelles with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>3</mn></msub><msub><mfenced><msub><mi>CH</mi><mn>2</mn></msub></mfenced><mn>16</mn></msub></math> group pointing towards the centre of sphere
